question: The United Nations International Day of Women and Girls in Science is annually observed on __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**11th February **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The United Nations International Day of Women and Girls in Science is celebrated annually on February 11
 
• The day promotes gender equality in science and technology by: 
 
 
• Encouraging women and girls to participate fully and equally in science 
 
• Raising awareness of the challenges women face in STEM fields 
 
• Advocating for more opportunities and support for women in STEM 
 
 
 
• UNESCO and UN Women work with other institutions and civil society partners to implement the day 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 15th February: This date is observed as International Childhood Cancer Day, which raises awareness and promotes efforts to support children and adolescents with cancer, survivors, and their families.
 
• 15th January: This day is celebrated as Indian Army Day in India to honor the bravery and sacrifice of the Indian Army personnel. It marks the day in 1949 when General K.M. Cariappa took command of the Indian Army from the British.
 
• 29th January: This day is observed as World Leprosy Day (on the last Sunday of January, though it sometimes falls on 29th) to increase public awareness about leprosy, eliminate stigma, and support those affected by the disease.
